candidates.hint: OpenAI's frontier model. Suited to complex, in-depth research, incident investigation, automation, and advanced engineering. Use medium or high for ordinary tasks; reserve xhigh and max for tasks with ambiguous context, easy to derail, requiring high autonomy and complex reasoning. OpenAI's economical model. Suited to simple tasks with clear context and well-defined goals: small feature additions, bug fixes, and scoped documentation, research, and automation.

Anthropic's frontier model. Suited to complex tasks with ambiguous context: research, investigation, engineering, and code review. It may refuse topics related to cybersecurity and frontier LLM research.
Anthropic's workhorse model. Suited to day-to-day cross-system research, investigation, engineering, and code review.

Currently points to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: highly cost-effective with fast output. On tasks with clear context, boundaries, and goals it approaches frontier-model quality. Use low for routine work like git commits; high and max for harder tasks needing detailed reasoning. Leave tasks with ambiguous context or requirements — likely to need long research and alignment — to stronger models.
